name: RAD50 double strand break repair protein

function.text: RAD50 encodes DNA repair protein RAD50. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Nijmegen breakage syndrome-like disorder (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Glioblastoma Multiforme. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
